what.title: What precision solutions do we deliver for critical industries?
what.intro: Texas Technical Services delivers precision-engineered solutions across flow measurement, inspection, and industrial automation — trusted by leading operators since 2008.

services.title: Flow Measurement & Control
services.desc: Comprehensive custody metering, flow computers, metering skids, and control system upgrades for liquid, gas, and water applications.

services.title: Inspection & Testing
services.desc: Specialised NDT, validation and mechanical testing of metering systems with full ISO-certified consultancy support.

services.title: Industrial Automation
services.desc: End-to-end plant automation — PLC, SCADA, HMI, VFDs and CEMS for oil & gas, power, and manufacturing sectors.

paragraphs: Extensive expertise in liquid and gas custody metering, Industrial Automation, and Inspection & Testing. Our services cover metering control upgrades, maintenance, validation, and specialised consultancy.
Committed to end-to-end metering solutions through strategic OEM partnerships — metering skids, flow computers, CEMS analysers, and field instruments across oil & gas, power, and commercial sectors.

services.title: What services do we offer for industrial automation and flow measurement?
services.intro: Extensive expertise in custody metering, industrial automation, and inspection & testing — since 2008.

items.title: Flow Measurement & Control System Solutions
items.body: Metering control system upgrades, maintenance, and validation for custody metering systems. Ensuring your metering operates accurately to API, AGA, and ISO standards.

items.title: Inspection & Testing
items.body: Comprehensive inspection, non-destructive testing, functional testing and certification across all industrial sectors. Full ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, UASL and Accurate compliance.

items.title: Industrial Process Automation Solutions
items.body: Control system design, PLC programming, SCADA integration, and HMI development — optimising operations across oil & gas, power, and manufacturing plants.

solutions.title: Which proprietary platforms deliver proven results?

items.label: Texaflow
items.title: Custody Metering Integrated Control System
items.desc: Proprietary fiscal metering & SCADA solution for oil & gas terminals, refineries, pipeline stations, and loading facilities — automated meter proving, real-time flow computer integration, and regulatory compliance.

items.label: Space AI
items.title: Industrial AI & Machine Learning
items.desc: Next-generation AI for industry — predictive maintenance, process optimization with virtual metrology & digital twins, and smart monitoring with ESG & carbon tracking. Reduce unplanned downtime by up to 50%.

about.title: Why was Texas Technical Services established in 2008?
about.text: Texas Technical Service Company is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company established in 2008. Primarily focused on flow measurement, inspection & testing, and industrial automation for oil & gas, power plants, manufacturing and commercial sectors.

cta.title: How can we solve your flow measurement challenge?
cta.text: From custody metering to full plant automation — our ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, UASL & Accurate certified team has delivered 400+ projects across oil & gas, power, and manufacturing since 2008.
